race.description: Boyles Estate Agents Professionals Mbk CG&E Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MAGURTZ (1) brings the most reliable recent form, having run second at Scone in BM58 grade last start after racing handy and holding on well, following another second at this track when beaten just over a length. The move back to Class 1 company, barrier 1 and first-time visors give him the right platform to convert that consistency. OVERZONE (2) is the main danger second-up, with his first-up fourth at Scone better than it reads after settling rearward and picking up nicely from an outsider quote. Placed twice from two attempts around this distance and has won at his only start at this track. BIG BRAD (4) is lightly raced and genuine, with a head second at Armidale before another placing at Scone, and his only previous run around 1450m was a win. PRINCE DE VEGA (6) has a touch more to prove after provincial runs at Gosford and Hawkesbury, but the last-start interference, easier country assignment and strong jockey booking keep him in the winning discussion.
